stem: To estimate lost sales, an analyst divides a TV's units sold in a 30-day month by all 30 days, including the 6 days it was sold out, and multiplies the result by 6. Compared with Voltmarkt's convention, what does this do to the estimate?

options.text: It understates the lost units, since the sold-out days pull the daily rate down
It overstates the lost units, since the sold-out days push the daily rate up
It changes nothing, since the days without stock add no units to the month's total
It turns the estimate into a stockout rate, since it divides by the days
